role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 凤凰冲入战斗，运用阳炎光线冲击敌人，治疗战友。到了适当时机，它可以化成一个燃烧的恒星，灼烧周围的仇敌，接着释放出令人眩晕的爆炸，使自己重获新生。
hero_summary_en: Diving into battle, Phoenix blasts enemies and heals allies with rays of solar flame. When the time is right, it can become a burning sun to scorch nearby foes before unleashing a stunning detonation that also restores Phoenix to full strength.

abilities.name: phoenix_icarus_dive
abilities.description_zh: 凤凰向目标方向进行圆弧状飞行，飞行距离固定，对沿途的敌人造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度，然后返回初始位置。飞行过程中如果施放超新星将停止飞行。
abilities.description_en: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
notes_zh: 凤凰冲击的飞行时间为%dive_duration%秒，可以在飞行途中再次施放来终止飞行。
notes_en: Icarus Dive has a %dive_duration% second travel duration, and can be cancelled by casting the ability again while in flight.

abilities.name: phoenix_fire_spirits
abilities.description_zh: 召唤4只围绕凤凰飞行的烈火精灵。每一只烈火精灵都能被单独发射到指定区域。对敌人持续造成伤害并大幅降低他们的攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
notes_zh: 烈火精灵现在到达目标区域后将获得1秒的视野。
notes_en: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.

shard_loc.en: Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.
shard_loc.zh: 烈火精灵变成被动充能技能。具有7秒充能时间。

abilities.name: phoenix_sun_ray
abilities.description_zh: 凤凰以损失生命能量为代价，向前射出一束炽热的光线炙烤敌人。光线对敌人造成伤害，并且能治疗友军，伤害和治疗的数值均为基础数值加上目标最大生命值的一定百分比。随着光线不断炙烤，百分比也会不断增加。
abilities.description_en: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
notes_zh: 烈日炙烤的宽度为%radius%，长度为%abilitycastrange%。
凤凰受到眩晕、沉默、飓风、妖术或睡眠等效果时烈日炙烤将会中断。
凤凰可以使用物品和其他技能，不会打断烈日炙烤。
notes_en: Sun Ray has a width of %radius% units, and a length of %abilitycastrange% units.
Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
Phoenix can use items and abilities without canceling Sun Ray.

shard_loc.en: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.
shard_loc.zh: 超新星期间可以施放烈日炙烤。

abilities.name: phoenix_dying_light
abilities.description_zh: 凤凰每秒对%radius%范围内所有敌人造成%damage_pct%%%自身缺失生命值的魔法伤害。
abilities.description_en: Phoenix deals %damage_pct%%% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a %radius% radius every second.
notes_zh: 消逝之光在凤凰变身为超新星期间也会造成伤害。
notes_en: Dying Light deals damage while Phoenix is transformed during Supernova.

abilities.name: phoenix_supernova
abilities.description_zh:
凤凰十分乐意终结自己现在的生命来换取重生。将自己变为一颗燃烧的恒星，灼烧附近一大片区域内的敌人。恒星受到敌方英雄一定次数的攻击后将会被摧毁。经过%abilityduration%秒后恒星将会爆炸，眩晕周围所有敌人。而凤凰的生命和魔法值都会回到满状态，并且所有技能的冷却时间都会刷新。

驱散类型：强驱散
abilities.description_en:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After %abilityduration% seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

scepter_loc.en: Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.
scepter_loc.zh: 摧毁超新星所需的攻击次数增加，凤凰可以对友方英雄施放超新星，使双方共同变为恒星进行重生。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_phoenix_dying_light_damage
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_damage_pct}% Dying Light Missing Health as Damage
